ci95: Student t interval for the mean only when n >= 2; conditional on the fixed protocol and seeds
cicids_unit: one run for a fixed scenario, model and seed; grouping is scenario x model
sequence_unit: one run for a fixed dataset, method and seed; deterministic methods have n=1
model_effect_unit: one scenario-level mean; five fixed scenarios, descriptive only
inferential_tests: none: five fixed scenarios are not a random population; n=5 seed repetitions are too limited for thesis-wide inference
forbidden_pooling: do not treat five scenarios as five identical repetitions
do not pool 25 CICIDS scenario-seed rows as independent replicates
do not compute dispersion for deterministic n=1 methods
do not infer significance between random split and scenario holdout
